verdict.rationale: CDP documents custodial accounts that can hold incoming stablecoins. Deposit destinations auto-credit the account balance, and auto-liquidation is optional, so funds can stay in stablecoin. Payouts in fiat or crypto can be sent from the same account. However, the evidence says nothing about where these accounts are available, which geographies are supported, or what gating applies (only a sandbox reference to SSN-based verification testing), and those are explicit parts of the story. Missing for 10: stated availability and supported geographies, documented eligibility/KYB gating terms, explicit statement of stablecoin balance holding and custody terms, independent corroboration.
